app.name: lensX

home.recentEmpty: Actions you use will appear here.
home.pinnedEmpty: Pin an action for quick access.

pluginRuntimeFailure.handshakeTimeout: The plugin page did not become ready in time. Retry to start again.
pluginRuntimeFailure.disconnected: The plugin page disconnected unexpectedly. Retry to start a fresh runtime.
pluginRuntimeFailure.securityPolicy: The plugin page was stopped by the application security policy.
pluginRuntimeFailure.crashLoop: This plugin has failed repeatedly. Wait briefly, then retry manually.
pluginRuntimeFailure.unavailable: The plugin page is unavailable. Retry to resolve the current plugin version.

preferences.startupFailure: Saved preferences could not be restored. Safe defaults are in use.

failure.actionExecutionFailed: The action could not be completed.

collections.syncFailure: The action completed, but its collection could not be updated.

theme.label: Color theme
theme.description: Choose how lensX and its Host surfaces appear.

locale.label: Language
locale.description: Choose the language used by lensX and Semi Design.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Install and manage plugins owned by this lensX host.
plugins.selectPrompt: Select a plugin to view its details.
plugins.quarantineDescription: This entry could not be loaded safely. Only removal is available.
plugins.degraded: lensX could not establish a trustworthy plugin snapshot. Retry after resolving the diagnostic.

development.title: Plugin Development Mode
development.description: Loads an unpacked, unsigned dist directory for this process only. It does not install, automatically run, or grant native Host access to the plugin.
development.toggle: Enable Plugin Development Mode for this process
development.processLocal: Process-local: the dedicated development command starts enabled, ordinary starts remain disabled, and turning it off lasts for this process.
development.unsignedDescription: This plugin is loaded from a Host-owned snapshot of an unpacked directory. Publisher text is unverified; it uses the same open Web and closed Host boundary as installed plugins.

feedback.enabled: Plugin Development Mode is enabled for this process.
feedback.disabled: Plugin Development Mode is disabled and development entries were removed. Plugin data and Launcher collections were retained.
feedback.registered: The development directory was registered with no native Host authority.
feedback.reloaded: The development entry was reloaded from a fresh snapshot.
feedback.removed: The development entry was removed. Plugin data and Launcher collections were retained.
feedback.cleanup_pending: Authority was updated, but old snapshot cleanup is still pending.
feedback.invalid: The selected dist directory is invalid or incomplete.
feedback.incompatible: The selected plugin is not compatible with this lensX version.
feedback.source_changed: The directory changed while lensX was reading it. Build again and retry.
feedback.conflict: Plugin state changed. The latest state has been loaded.
feedback.unsafe_state: Snapshot ownership could not be proven safely.
feedback.convergence_failed: The native change completed, but the visible plugin state could not be refreshed.
feedback.failed: The plugin development operation failed safely.

reload.title: Reload development plugin?
reload.description: Reload {{name}} from its selected dist directory? The current Runtime and all of its workers, connections, and sessions will end.

remove.title: Remove development entry?
remove.description: Remove {{name}} from this process? Plugin data and Launcher collections will be retained.

diagnostics.incompatible_contract: The plugin record uses an incompatible contract.
diagnostics.unknown: The plugin could not be loaded safely.

feedback.busy: Another plugin installation is in progress. Try again shortly.
feedback.cleanupPending: The change was saved, but some files still require cleanup.
feedback.conflict: Plugin state changed. The latest state has been loaded.
feedback.convergenceFailed: The change was saved, but the visible plugin state could not be refreshed.
feedback.detailFailed: Plugin details could not be loaded safely.
feedback.duplicate: This action is already in progress.
feedback.loadFailed: Plugins could not be loaded safely.
feedback.mutationFailed: The plugin change could not be completed.
feedback.pluginEnabled: Disable the plugin before clearing its data.
feedback.unavailable: Installation from a local file is unavailable right now.
feedback.unsafeStorage: Plugin data could not be changed because storage ownership could not be proven.

installation.title: Review plugin permissions
installation.description: Install {{name}} version {{version}}? All sensitive permissions are off by default.

replacement.title: Confirm replacement
replacement.description: Review the version and permission changes for {{name}}.

uninstall.title: Uninstall plugin
uninstall.retainDescription: Plugin data is retained by default for a future reinstall.
uninstall.deleteDescription: Owned plugin data will be deleted when its identity can be proven safely.

clear.title: Clear plugin data
clear.description: Permanently clear the data owned by disabled plugin {{name}}?

trust.title: Install as trust
trust.description: Installing trusts this plugin to process data you give it in an isolated, open Web runtime. lensX does not individually approve or endorse its workers, network requests, or remote resources, while native Host access remains closed.
trust.replacementDescription: Replacing this plugin trusts the new package and its remote Web behavior. Native Host access remains limited to the public Host API.

save.failure: The preference could not be saved. Your previous value is still active.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: lensX could not display this screen. Reload the application to try again.
